What is in the window

From the Instagram profile and what guests write in their Google reviews.

Macarons

Rows of macarons in many flavours. 8 reviews mention them, one guest writes there is a lot of flavour to choose.

Tarts and small cakes

Lemon tart, pistachio strawberry, pavlova, mille feuille and more. 7 reviews mention the lemon tart.

Cakes to order

Custom orders are welcome, for example a birthday cake with a printed picture on top. Orders can be arranged by phone.

Coffee and gelato

Specialty coffee and homemade gelato to go with the sweets.

Made fresh daily

Pastries and desserts are handmade and made fresh every day, as the shop writes on Instagram.

Made to look at

Guests praise the decoration. One calls the shop an art gallery with edible sweet masterpieces.

Friendly staff

11 reviews mention the helpful staff. One guest describes them as professional, warm and funny.

On Gerasimou Markora

At Gerasimou Markora 8 in Nicosia. Open every day, on Sunday from 11:00 to 18:00.
